The file sidebar now makes files where VS Code's Explorer does, and has a
button of its own to fold it away and bring it back. More at
[www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## New

- **New files from the Explorer.** Double-clicking the space below the tree's
  entries starts a *New file* prompt in the folder the tree is showing, as
  VS Code's Explorer does — whatever entry happens to be picked no longer
  changes where the file lands. A double click that lands on a row is still
  the row's own click, so opening a file cannot leave a new one behind.
- **Toggle Side Bar in the title bar.** A folded-away Explorer used to leave
  its only way back inside a menu; it now has a button beside the layout
  controls, lit while the sidebar is shown, that folds it away and brings it
  back.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon) | `Malgel-0.1.11-macos-arm64.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.11-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.11-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.11-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.11-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks it after download: right-click it and choose Open once, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Malgel.app`. The Windows files are unsigned: SmartScreen may warn, and **More info → Run anyway** gets past it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
